content.value_statement: Inconsistent styling makes decks, reports, and pages harder to review. Theme Factory provides preset palettes, font pairings, and selection guidance for consistent artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Shows a PDF showcase of ten available themes for user selection.
Applies selected color palettes and fonts to slides, documents, reports, and HTML pages.
Uses theme files that list hex colors, font pairings, and suitable use cases.
Asks for explicit theme confirmation before applying a theme.
Creates a custom theme when preset options do not fit the artifact.
Checks contrast and readability while applying visual styling.
limitations: It provides theme guidance, not a full design review workflow.
It depends on the host tool's ability to edit the target artifact.
It does not include automated accessibility testing or contrast scoring.
Custom themes require enough user context to choose useful colors and fonts.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Roadmap Deck
use_cases.description: Apply a professional theme to make planning slides easier to scan and share.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Reports
use_cases.description: Use one theme across recurring reports so teams present a consistent client experience.

use_cases.title: Theme an HTML Prototype
use_cases.description: Apply a preset or custom visual direction to a landing page draft.

prompt_templates.title: Show Theme Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the theme showcase and help me choose a theme for this presentation deck.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner selection before any styling changes.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this quarterly report. Preserve the current structure and improve readability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a named preset on an existing artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a healthcare analytics briefing. Use calm colors, clear typography, and high contrast.
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a theme when presets do not fit.

prompt_templates.title: Recommend and Apply
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this deck, recommend the best preset or custom theme, explain the choice, then apply it consistently after confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with recommendation and user approval.

output_examples.input: User asks to restyle a sales deck with a calm professional look.
output_examples.output: The assistant shows the showcase, asks for a theme, and applies Ocean Depths after confirmation.

output_examples.input: User needs a custom visual style for a healthcare analytics briefing.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a custom healthcare theme with soft blues, clear fonts, and contrast guidance.

output_examples.input: User wants an HTML landing page to feel more modern and technical.
output_examples.output: The assistant applies Tech Innovation colors, matching typography, and consistent emphasis across the page.

best_practices: Review the showcase before choosing a preset theme.
Confirm the selected theme before applying changes to the artifact.
Check readability on every slide or page after styling.
anti_patterns: Applying a theme before the user selects or approves it.
Mixing colors from multiple presets without a clear reason.
Ignoring existing brand requirements or accessibility needs.

faq.question: What types of artifacts can it style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for decks, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: It includes ten preset themes with colors, fonts, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a custom theme from your audience, tone, and artifact goals.

faq.question: Does it change content structure?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on visual styling unless you request broader content changes.

faq.question: Does it run scripts or commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructions describe reading theme files and showing a PDF showcase.

faq.question: Should I provide brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. Brand colors, fonts, and accessibility needs help produce better theme choices.
